definition: faith, belief, trust, confidence; fidelity, faithfulness

usages.text: Now faith is confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see.

definition: love, goodwill, esteem; especially divine love

usages.text: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.
